title.en: Chapter 18 — The Old Man of the Sea

book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.ar: لقيت رجل كبير قاعد جنب نهر.
sentences.en: I found an old man sitting beside a river.

sentences.ar: أشر لي إنه بده يعبر عالتاني.
sentences.en: He signalled to me that he wanted to cross to the other side.
I carried him on my shoulders in all kindness.
When we crossed, he would not get down.
He wrapped his legs around my neck and squeezed.
He stayed on my back for days and days.
I would eat and sleep with him on top of me.
